column5: The existing lack_handles leaf remains executable after ownership consolidation, and the IndexReader post-lowering lifecycle now consumes already-built requests through the canonical injected query runtime: Open transfers every response once, ordered Next forwards its remaining caller row budget through serial/select/query response owners, and explicit or RAII Close releases every opened response exactly once. Physical-plan/DAG/range construction, KV handle encoding, lookup workers, consistency reporting, sorted merging, response-close errors, and concrete storage remain open.

The TableReader post-lowering lifecycle now owns ordered already-built requests, one-way raw-response-to-decoder transfer, remaining-budget row pulls, partial-open cleanup, idempotent explicit and RAII close, and structural Table/Index dummy-reader identity with zero transport sends. DAG/range construction, correlated columns, signed/unsigned range splitting, partitions, TiFlash batch/MPP, virtual columns, memory/index-usage accounting, sorted merging, UnionScan materialization, and concrete transport remain open.
